thesis: The bull carries consolidated operating merit because matched revenue and operating-income growth rebuts generalised deterioration. Neutral separates that merit from unknown post-infrastructure cash and normalised entry value. Cloud gross-margin pressure remains independent counterevidence against assuming stable incremental capacity returns.
strongest_counterexample: Cloud gross margin declined with infrastructure and mix, while debt/FCF are unextracted and RSI above76 accompanies upper-band extension; consolidated earnings do not establish marginal cloud cash returns.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable quarter reports operating-income growth below revenue growth, with operating margin below the observed45.11%, invalidating the retained matched-growth profitability premise.
A matched infrastructure cash bridge shows post-investment cash at or below zero while cash-funded obligations exceed available resources, defeating a funded-growth extension of the thesis.
evidence_gaps: Incremental cloud-unit economics and post-infrastructure cash.
Debt, FCF and funding of shareholder distributions.
EPS normalisation excluding investment/discrete items and matched valuation.
decisive_factors: Azure +43% and cloud +27% are realised revenue growth.
Group operating income and cloud gross margin are different measures; EPS benefits need normalisation.
